question: What was Rowling doing when she started writing Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Teaching**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage states that Rowling started writing **"Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone"** while she was in Portugal, where she was teaching English. This clearly indicates **that she was engaged in teaching at the time she began the book.**
 
• In summary, **option 3 best describes** what Rowling was doing when she started writing "Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone," according to the details provided in the passage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Designing:** There is no mention in the passage of Rowling being involved in designing at the time she started writing the book.
 
• **Writing full-time:** The passage does not indicate that she was writing full-time; instead, it mentions that she was teaching English.
 
• **Accounting:** The passage does not mention any involvement in accounting whatsoever.
